title: CLI 3.6.2: Subagent Stop Hooks and Guided Compaction
summary: This release lets you turn on Approve for me from a permission prompt and brings V3 headless runs closer to V2. It also shows tool-call reasons in the Lean preset and fixes notification, startup, and sign-in issues.
